name: global-agent-setup
description: Analyze a software project and produce a safe, auditable setup plan for skills, plugins, MCP servers, and built-in tools.

interface.shortDescription: Plan the right agent stack for a project.
interface.longDescription: Inspects an existing or new project, matches its needs against a curated component registry, and produces a reviewable setup plan before any installation or configuration change.
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze this project and propose the skills, plugins, MCP servers, and tools it needs.
